name: teams
description: A sibling of graph for requests too big for one pass: a TaskManager MCP (task-manager) sizes the request; size L is planned into a PRD and user stories, split into packages that each run the full harness in their own worktree, integrated, QA'd and gated by a background daemon; size S is handed to the development harness. Entry skills teams:orchestrate/develop/document/plan/qa/sprint, board and ticket views (tm_board, teams:board). Runs are kept under .teams_output/ and ~/.harness/tasks/. Zero runtime dependencies beyond Node 18+.
